evidence_tiers.A0-L: existing library-native primitive not yet proven reachable on the production cognitive path
evidence_tiers.A0-R: frozen condition-blind readout of pre-existing production representation

promotion_rule: A response mapping may be admitted only before confirmatory execution, after development-only evidence shows all required capability atoms, semantic completeness, condition blindness, source-SHA binding, state-scope declaration, metamorphic validity, and for A0-D live runtime reachability or for A0-R a frozen readout that does not reimplement the PARADOX theorem.
